summary.intent: Open a CI pull request for spec fixes, then bump the michi-graph dependency to 0.10 on a new branch off main and validate it with the full workspace checks.
summary.outcome: PR #554 was opened for the spec fixes. The michi-graph bump branch was created, Cargo.toml and the lockfile were updated to 0.10, and a check script (tests, clippy, fmt, deny) was run. The transcript does not show the results of the checks.

repo: The project is a Cargo workspace that depends on michi-graph (bumped to 0.10).
Dependency bumps are validated with workspace tests, clippy, fmt and cargo-deny.
Branches are linked to a docs trail as part of the workflow.
workflow: Spec fixes and dependency bumps are kept in separate branches and PRs, with the bump branched off main.
Bundling the multi-step checks (test, clippy, fmt, deny) into one script, check_bump.sh, makes them easy to rerun.

open_items: The results of the workspace tests, clippy, fmt and deny on the michi-graph 0.10 bump are not shown, so they need to be confirmed.
No PR for the michi-graph bump has been opened yet.
